# typed_graphql_client

![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-%5E3.13-0175C2?logo=dart&logoColor=white)
![Role](https://img.shields.io/badge/role-client-blue)
![Part of](https://img.shields.io/badge/part%20of-typed__graphql-purple)

**A fully typed GraphQL client for Dart and Flutter: the client, typed responses, links, MockLink and uploads, for operations generated by typed_graphql_codegen.** Part of [typed_graphql](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart).

> **Status: under construction.** This release holds the contract that code
> generated by `typed_graphql_codegen` compiles against, `GraphQLClient` and
> the sealed `GraphQLResponse`, the link chain (`Link`, `SplitLink`,
> `ContextLink`, `MockLink`), `Backoff` and the upload types (`UploadFile`,
> `UploadFileCodec`, `UploadFiles`). It has no link that talks to a server
> yet: use `MockLink` in tests. Status text elsewhere (`docs/discovery.md`,
> `llms.txt`, the root `CLAUDE.md`) is updated by stage M11f.

The guides describe each part: [Generated Operations](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart/blob/main/packages/typed_graphql_client/doc/operations.md),
[Client](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart/blob/main/packages/typed_graphql_client/doc/client.md),
[Links](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart/blob/main/packages/typed_graphql_client/doc/links.md) and
[Uploads](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart/blob/main/packages/typed_graphql_client/doc/uploads.md).
The part of typed_graphql that sends requests over the network today is the
server side, [typed_graphql_server](https://github.com/4akloon/graphql_dart/tree/main/packages/typed_graphql_server).

Planned: `HttpLink` (M11b), the policies (M11c), `WebSocketLink` (M11d) and `SseLink` (M11e); the normalized cache and `watchQuery` (M12).
